summary: Iteration 5 — verified Top Deals of the Day backend endpoint and the new /deals UI page plus its Home QuickAction entry. Backend: 10 passed, 1 skipped (sort-order check needed >=2 deals; only 1 deal currently in DB). Frontend: /deals page renders hero + DealCard with -33% badge and crossed-out market_median price, click navigates to /listing/:id. Home QuickActions now has 5 items including data-testid='quick-صفقات اليوم'. Regression: /auctions, /forgot-password, /listing/:id price-badge all OK.

minor.issue: Sort order test skipped because only 1 qualifying deal exists in DB. Endpoint logic is correct (sorted DESC by discount_pct in code); needs more diverse seed data to exercise full sort path.

issues: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' originating from NearbySection. Cause: '<>' fragment shorthand used inside .map() with keys placed on inner children instead of on the fragment. Fix: replace '<>' with '<React.Fragment key={l.id}>' (and a separate key for the AdSlotInline). Pre-existing; not introduced by Iteration 5 but still spammy in console.

action_items: Optional: seed 2-3 more deal-eligible listings (price < 80% of category+subcategory median, with >=3 listings per group) so sort-order test can run live.
Fix React key warning in HomePage.js NearbySection by switching '<>' to keyed React.Fragment in both grid and wide layouts.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/deals/today: scans only first 500 listings via .limit(500) — if catalogue grows large, deals could be silently missed. Consider an aggregation pipeline ($group + $bucket) instead of in-memory grouping for scalability.

/api/deals/today does not filter by 'today' (creation date / freshness) despite the name. All active+approved listings are eligible; consider adding a created_at >= now-24h filter or rename to 'best_deals' to match behavior.
HomePage.js: '<>' fragments inside .map cause React key warnings (see UI design issues).

DealsPage.js: api.get('/deals/today', { params: { country_code: user?.country_code } }) — when user is logged out, this is undefined, axios will likely send 'country_code=undefined' string. Should pass the param only when defined.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 ran, 1 skipped due to sparse data)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (deals UI + home QA + 3 regression flows all pass)

seed_data_creation: None created. One pre-existing deal (TEST 360 سيارة جميلة, -33% off, RIYADH) was sufficient to validate shape, badge, and crossed-out median UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 adds GET /api/deals/today + /deals page + a 5th quick-action 'صفقات اليوم' on Home. All passed. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_deals.py. Only known pre-existing console warning is the React 'unique key' warning in HomePage.js NearbySection (not introduced this iteration). Sort-order assertion is gated on having >=2 deals; if seed grows, it will activate automatically.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects blocking the iteration. The single skipped test is data-dependent, not code-defective.
